summary_markdown:
A new logic was developed to recalculate Value Added (VA) on the fly using a second site's service. This allows for adjusting road visibility status (visible/invisible). If the segment data incorrectly displays visibility, changing this status will trigger a VA recalculation. After saving, the record can be updated with 'approved by AU'.

This feature is expected to be useful for specific team members and can potentially be tested via different channels.

Regarding production vs. beta environments: The logic only affects the beta environment using current data. Production will only use data from frames that have been explicitly approved (status: Ready), which happens annually.

Previously, adjustments were made during inventory processes, but this specific functionality was not part of a client-ordered package. However, validation efforts suggest there will be many cases requiring manual data adjustment.
decisions: Implement logic to recalculate VA by adjusting road visibility status.
